label: Dahua XVR5108HS-I3
description: Dahua XVR5108HS-I3 is an 8-channel Penta-brid recorder: 8 BNC inputs for HDCVI/AHD/TVI/CVBS, 4 IP channels by default expandable to 12 by converting analog channels, H.265+/AI coding, one SATA port up to 16 TB and 64 Mbps each way. It has one RJ45 10/100 Mbps Ethernet port, a 12 VDC 2 A input, no PoE and no wireless radio.
notes: From the Dahua datasheet: 'Network Port 1 (10/100 Mbps Ethernet port, RJ-45)'; 8-channel analog camera input (CVI/AHD/TVI/CVBS); up to 12 channels of IPC access, 4 IP channels by default plus 8 converted analog channels; incoming/recording/outgoing bandwidth 64 Mbps each; 1 SATA port up to 16 TB; 12 VDC 2 A, <7 W; 2x USB 2.0; HDMI + VGA; 1 RS-485 for PTZ; ONVIF 21.06, CGI. Sold as the XVR5108HS family - these figures are from the -I3 revision datasheet, and the older non-I3 builds differ in codec support. The 8 BNC inputs are analog video, not network ports, so they are not modelled. Not confirmed: Dahua publishes no draw figure with a 16 TB disk fitted, and no PoE capability.
